metadata.description: The Claude Code mods I use on every machine, pulled from their upstream repos.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel (/agents-info).

plugins.name: savvy-flow
plugins.description: /savvy-flow:savvy-flow <task>: plans, hands the work to five tiered worker agents and reviews it. Its agents get the animated costumes in savvy-progress.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree with git status and shimmer on files Claude touches.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Tool rows with icons, diff/table/Mermaid cards, a usage band and fifteen themes (/skin).
